hosts.name: RackNerd
hosts.notes: Unmanaged KVM VPS with full root. n8n is a one-click app in RackNerd's ctrl panel (needs 2+ vCPU and 2+ GB RAM; the install wipes the VPS first), and RackNerd's Terms of Service allow Docker/Compose containers (no nested virtualization). The lowest prices are 12-month prepaid plans on RackNerd's Specials page (renewal at the same rate per RackNerd's FAQ, but plans are 'while available' and can change). Monthly list-price plans cost several times more per month. Support is advertised as 24/7; we have not tested its quality. Refunds are case-by-case. StackCost earns a commission if you order through the View deal link (affiliate); this does not change rankings.

plans.name: 2 GB KVM (yearly)
plans.note: 12-month prepay ($35.99/yr); 2-year option at exactly 2x. RackNerd's FAQ says the yearly plan renews at the same rate. Locations at checkout: New York, Los Angeles, Chicago, Dallas, Seattle. Unmanaged; refunds case-by-case per its ToS. Meets n8n one-click minimum (2 vCPU / 2 GB); RackNerd suggests 4 GB for production with Postgres.
